title: Trump Threatens Global Economy, Iran Promises Broad Response, Israel Kills 29 Palestinians
author: Murtaza Hussain
content:
In this week's War Brief, Murtaza Hussain and Sarmad Jawad discuss Donald
Trump's renewed threats to attack Iran, the deployment of additional U.S.
military assets to the region, and coordination with the Israeli military.
Iran, meanwhile, is testing advanced ballistic missiles and has warned that it
will respond forcefully to any attack, including by targeting energy
infrastructure and cutting crucial undersea internet cables.  
  
The team also looks at developments in Ukraine as well as Israel's bloody week
in Gaza, where Israeli forces are launching an average of 50 strikes a day. At
least 29 Palestinians, including women and children, have been killed.
